# Security policy

Relay handles clipboard contents, files, input control, and camera, microphone and screen streams, so security reports are taken seriously.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting on this repository (Security tab, "Report a vulnerability"). Include the affected version, steps to reproduce and the impact.

## Scope

Pairing and authentication, transport encryption, file and path handling, clipboard handling, input injection, and the camera, microphone, audio and screen sharing components.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes.

## Status

Relay is in beta and has had no external security audit. The [threat model](docs/THREAT_MODEL.md) describes what it tries to protect and its known limits.
